task: Deliver a tiny Python CLI `todo` in this directory (`add <text>`, `list`, `done <id>`; JSON-file persistence) by coordinating subagents through specification → tests → implementation → review. Keep a shared audit trail `workflow-log.jsonl` in this directory: one JSON line per substantive worker action, carrying the worker's id.

workers.goal: Write SPEC.md defining add <text>, list, and done <id>, their JSON persistence model, observable outputs, and errors. Done when every command has Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.
Write black-box pytest tests derived solely from SPEC.md for the todo CLI. Done when the suite collects and exposes missing or non-conforming implementation.
Implement the todo CLI to satisfy SPEC.md and test_todo.py, with JSON-file persistence. Done when all tests in test_todo.py pass.
